title: Education
subtitles: Children not in School: Statutory Guidance

speakers.name: Paul Waugh
speakers.role: The Parliamentary Under-Secretary of State for Education

contributions.who: The Parliamentary Under-Secretary of State for Education (Paul Waugh)
contributions.text: All children deserve to receive a suitable education that enables them to thrive and achieve, and the Government are committed to ensuring that no child misses out. The Government have today launched a consultation on “Children Not in School: Statutory Guidance and Secondary Legislation”. This consultation sets out our proposals to help ensure that every child not in school is receiving a safe and suitable education. Parents have a right to home educate, and we know many work hard to provide a suitable education for their children. Where parents choose to home educate, they must provide an efficient, full-time education suitable to the child’s age, ability, aptitude and any special educational needs. Where a child is not receiving a suitable education, it is important that local authorities are able to identify this and take prompt, appropriate action.
